focus.title: 欧盟拟对中国电动汽车加征17%-36%反补贴关税，7月4日临时生效
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于6月12日通知中国商务部，计划对进口自中国的纯电动汽车加征17%至36%的反补贴关税，临时关税将于7月4日起实施。受影响企业包括比亚迪、吉利、上汽等，特斯拉可能适用个别税率。中欧双方正在就价格承诺等解决方案进行磋商，但短期内出口成本将显著上升。建议企业立即审查供应链与定价策略，并考虑通过海外建厂或调整市场布局应对。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会官方公报 · 2026.06.19
focus.title_en: EU Plans 17%-36% Anti-Subsidy Tariffs on Chinese EVs, Effective July 4
focus.summary_en: On June 12, the European Commission notified China's Ministry of Commerce of its plan to impose anti-subsidy tariffs of 17% to 36% on battery electric vehicles imported from China, with provisional duties taking effect on July 4. Affected companies include BYD, Geely, SAIC, while Tesla may receive an individual rate. China and the EU are negotiating possible solutions such as price undertakings, but short-term export costs will rise significantly. Companies should immediately review supply chains and pricing strategies, and consider overseas manufacturing or market diversification.
focus.source_en: Source: Official Journal of the European Union · 2026.06.19

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：数据合规义务不因合同终止而免除，违反GDPR可被追责
case.summary: 在SIAC案号2025/089的仲裁中，一家中国跨境电商企业被裁决赔偿新加坡合作方因数据泄露造成的损失。仲裁庭认定，数据合规义务属于持续性义务，不因主合同终止而消灭。该企业因未按GDPR要求采取适当技术措施，导致用户数据泄露，被裁定支付约120万欧元赔偿。该裁决警示出海企业：数据合规是长期责任，合同结束后仍需履行保护义务，否则将面临仲裁或诉讼风险。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）裁决摘要 · 2026年第2季度
case.title_en: SIAC Award: Data Compliance Obligations Survive Contract Termination; GDPR Violation Leads to Liability
case.summary_en: In SIAC Case No. 2025/089, a Chinese cross-border e-commerce company was ordered to compensate its Singaporean partner for losses caused by a data breach. The tribunal held that data compliance obligations are continuing duties and do not terminate upon contract expiration. The company failed to implement adequate technical measures under the GDPR, resulting in user data leakage, and was ordered to pay approximately €1.2 million in damages. The award warns overseas-bound companies that data protection is a long-term responsibility, and non-compliance may lead to arbitration or litigation even after the contract ends.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) Award Summary · Q2 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”机制扩围，新增医疗与金融领域
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室于6月15日发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理规定（试行）》修订版，将“白名单”机制适用范围从原有的跨境电商、供应链管理等领域扩展至医疗健康与金融服务。纳入白名单的企业在满足安全评估要求后，可便利化地向港澳传输个人数据与重要数据。该政策降低了大湾区企业跨境合规成本，但企业仍需建立内部数据分类分级制度，并完成备案。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.06.15
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow 'Whitelist' Expanded to Healthcare and Finance
policy.summary_en: On June 15, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province released a revised version of the 'Regulations on the Security Management of Cross-Border Data Flow in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Trial)', extending the whitelist mechanism from e-commerce and supply chain management to healthcare and financial services. Companies on the whitelist can transfer personal and important data to Hong Kong and Macao with simplified procedures after meeting security assessment requirements. This policy reduces cross-border compliance costs for GBA enterprises, but companies must still establish internal data classification systems and complete filings.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · 2026.06.15

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟关税与数据合规双重压力下，出海企业应建立“法律+商业”联动应对机制
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：当前欧盟对华电动汽车反补贴关税与GDPR执法趋严形成双重合规压力，企业不能再将法律与商业决策分离。建议出海企业：（1）在投资欧洲前进行关税与数据合规尽职调查，评估建厂或合资的可行性；（2）合同中加入关税调整条款与数据保护持续义务条款；（3）建立法律、税务、供应链跨部门小组，定期更新合规清单。短期可通过价格承诺谈判争取缓冲，中长期应实现供应链本地化与数据本地化。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 涉外律师团队 · 2026.06.19
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Under EU Tariff and Data Compliance Pressures, Outbound Companies Should Establish a 'Legal + Business' Joint Response Mechanism
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The dual pressures of EU anti-subsidy tariffs on Chinese EVs and stricter GDPR enforcement mean companies can no longer separate legal and business decisions. Recommendations for outbound companies: (1) conduct tariff and data compliance due diligence before investing in Europe, assessing feasibility of factory construction or joint ventures; (2) include tariff adjustment clauses and data protection continuing obligations in contracts; (3) establish cross-departmental teams covering legal, tax, and supply chain to regularly update compliance checklists. In the short term, negotiate price undertakings for a buffer; in the medium to long term, achieve supply chain and data localization.
